 How to watch Cincinnati vs Houston
 Date: Saturday, November 7, 2026
 Time: 3:30 PM EDT
 Channel: FOX
 Stream: Fubo ( try for free ) 
 Cincinnati is sliding down the Big 12 table after a run of three losses in its last four games as it travels to face No. 17 Houston this Saturday. The 3-2 Cougars (6-2 overall) are back at TDECU Stadium after a bye week and have a feline scrap on their hands against the 2-3 Bearcats (5-3 overall), hoping to bounce back following defeat to No. 3 Utah two weeks ago.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Houston has lost its last five matchups with Cincy and suffered a 34-0 blowout defeat when these programs last faced off in September 2024. Third-year head coach Willie Fritz has made significant improvements since then, however, as the power balance in the Big 12 has undergone a transformation ahead of this reunion.
 To call the Bearcats a team of two halves would be an understatement given just how lopsided the roster is, boasting the 18th-best offense in the country but a defense that ranks 132nd. Houston mirrors that trend to some extent, though not nearly to the same extreme given its 12th-ranked offense is mirrored by the No. 65 defense in the nation.
 Cincy's attacking output is also centered largely around a rush offense that's currently seventh in the country, which is exactly where Houston is best in defense and allows just 100.5 yards per game. Junior running back Cole Tabb leads the Bearcats with 752 rushing yards and 10 touchdowns this term, and locking him down will prove crucial considering even his output has remained fairly prolific throughout Cincinnati's recent sour patch, averaging 9.3 yards per carry and scoring four times across their last three games.
